title: Choose a common neighbourhood making an existing marked curve diagram good
statement: Let f:X→S, η∈U⊆S, g:V→U finite surjective universally injective, and σ:Z→V with every point mapping to η in S. Fix finitely many commuting diagrams Y_i→B_i→T_i→V with finite etale T_i→V, open Y_i→B_i, smooth proper B_i→T_i and finite surjective ν:∐Y_i→X_V. Let W⊆X_V make ν a thickening. Suppose every point s∈T_i over η has geometrically connected proper fibre of dimension at most one and lies in the image of the marked open in Y_i. Then a restriction to some open neighbourhood U'⊆S of η gives V'→U', a lift of σ and an open immersion V'→V compatible over S, with restricted diagrams all of whose proper fibres satisfy those conditions, smooth surjective open parts, and a marked open surjecting onto every T'_i and making ν' a thickening. The old and new diagrams are related by cartesian squares over V'→V, commuting with j_i,p_i. [def-pc-scheme] [def-pc-scheme-fibre] [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] [def-sbc-first-order-thickening]

proof.text:
For each T_i, geometric connectedness is open in the proper smooth family,
and the fibre-dimension-at-most-one locus is open by proper upper semicontinuity.
The marked open in Y_i is smooth over T_i, so its image is open. Intersect these
three opens. The hypotheses put every point above η in this intersection.
Each composite T_i→V→U is finite. Apply the simultaneous finite-image shrinking
lemma to these composites and the threefold intersections, obtaining an affine
neighbourhood U₀ of η inside U whose inverse images lie in all those intersections.
The specified σ maps into its inverse image because every point maps to η.
Apply the restriction theorem to U₀. It provides U', V' and the restricted diagram.
Base change preserves finiteness, surjectivity, etaleness, open immersions, smoothness,
properness, and thickenings. Coproducts commute with this base change; the original
commuting triangles restrict to the new ones. The three chosen loci give precisely
the asserted fibre conditions and marked surjectivity. Since the marked open is
contained in Y'_i, the latter surjectivity also gives surjectivity of Y'_i→T'_i.
All comparison squares are restriction pullback squares. The specified map σ lifts
uniquely because its image lies in V'. If n=0, take U'=U and all restrictions at the
top open; all component conditions are vacuous. No reducedness or genericity is needed.

theorem exists_marked_curve_diagram_refinement
    {X S V Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (U : S.Opens) (η : S) (hη : η ∈ U)
    (g : V ⟶ U.toScheme) [IsFinite g] [Surjective g] [UniversallyInjective g]
    (σ : Z ⟶ V) (hσ : ∀ z : Z, (g ≫ U.ι) (σ z) = η)
    (n : ℕ) (T Y B : Fin n → Scheme.{u}) (t : ∀ i, T i ⟶ V)
    (j : ∀ i, Y i ⟶ B i) (p : ∀ i, B i ⟶ T i)
    (ν : (∐ Y) ⟶ pullback f (g ≫ U.ι)) [IsFinite ν] [Surjective ν]
    (hcomm : ∀ i, Sigma.ι Y i ≫ ν ≫ pullback.snd f (g ≫ U.ι) = j i ≫ p i ≫ t i)
    (ht : ∀ i, IsFinite (t i) ∧ Etale (t i))
    (hj : ∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (j i)) (hp : ∀ i, Smooth (p i) ∧ IsProper (p i))
    (W : (pullback f (g ≫ U.ι)).Opens) (hW : IsThickening (pullback.snd ν W.ι))
    (hgood : ∀ i (s : T i), (t i ≫ g ≫ U.ι) s = η →
      GeometricallyConnected ((p i).fiberToSpecResidueField s) ∧
      topologicalKrullDim ((p i).fiber s) ≤ 1 ∧
      s ∈ Set.range (((Sigma.ι Y i ≫ ν) ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι ≫ j i ≫ p i)) :
    ∃ (U' : S.Opens) (_ : η ∈ U') (V' : Scheme.{u}) (g' : V' ⟶ U'.toScheme),
      IsFinite g' ∧ Surjective g' ∧ UniversallyInjective g' ∧
      ∃ (aV : V' ⟶ V) (σ' : Z ⟶ V'),
        IsOpenImmersion aV ∧ σ' ≫ aV = σ ∧
        aV ≫ g ≫ U.ι = g' ≫ U'.ι ∧
        ∃ (T' Y' B' : Fin n → Scheme.{u})
          (t' : ∀ i, T' i ⟶ V') (j' : ∀ i, Y' i ⟶ B' i)
          (p' : ∀ i, B' i ⟶ T' i)
          (ν' : (∐ Y') ⟶ pullback f (g' ≫ U'.ι)),
          IsFinite ν' ∧ Surjective ν' ∧
          (∀ i, Sigma.ι Y' i ≫ ν' ≫ pullback.snd f (g' ≫ U'.ι) =
            j' i ≫ p' i ≫ t' i) ∧
          (∀ i, IsFinite (t' i) ∧ Etale (t' i)) ∧
          (∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (j' i)) ∧
          (∀ i, Smooth (j' i ≫ p' i) ∧ Surjective (j' i ≫ p' i)) ∧
          (∀ i, Smooth (p' i) ∧ IsProper (p' i) ∧
            ∀ s : T' i, GeometricallyConnected ((p' i).fiberToSpecResidueField s) ∧
              topologicalKrullDim ((p' i).fiber s) ≤ 1) ∧
          (∃ W' : (pullback f (g' ≫ U'.ι)).Opens,
            (∀ i, Surjective (((Sigma.ι Y' i ≫ ν') ⁻¹ᵁ W').ι ≫ j' i ≫ p' i)) ∧
            IsThickening (pullback.snd ν' W'.ι)) ∧
          ∃ (aY : ∀ i, Y' i ⟶ Y i) (aB : ∀ i, B' i ⟶ B i)
            (aT : ∀ i, T' i ⟶ T i),
            ∀ i,
              IsPullback (aY i) (j' i ≫ p' i ≫ t' i) (j i ≫ p i ≫ t i) aV ∧
              IsPullback (aB i) (p' i ≫ t' i) (p i ≫ t i) aV ∧
              IsPullback (aT i) (t' i) (t i) aV ∧
              j' i ≫ aB i = aY i ≫ j i ∧ p' i ≫ aT i = aB i ≫ p i
